messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PROD | inference-gateway | 5xx error-rate spike | us-west2 | 2026-03-15T06:12:58Z — 5m rate 3.8% (>2%) :rotating_light:

pagerduty: Triggered PD incident #INC123456 — urgent. Paging escalation: sre_oncall (primary).

sre_oncall: ack — looking.

ben: acked in PD. I'll check canaries and recent deploys.

alice: saw a rollout completed in us-west2 at 06:10 UTC — envoy bumped 1.25 -> 1.26. Not sure if traffic-splitting changed.

ben: running quick checks: kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=inference-proxy
ben: logs show repeated 502s from upstream kvcache: 'upstream read timeout' and some 504s.

sre_oncall: initial impact: ~6% of requests for inference-gateway in us-west2 failing; small tenants affected, no enterprise SLA hits yet.

maria: getting pings from support — a customer in EU reported 5xx earlier but looks localized to us-west2.

ops_lead: can we route traffic away? alice, can you activate traffic-control runbook to shift 40% to us-east1?

alice: starting traffic shift: /runbook traffic-control shift --service inference-gateway --from us-west2 --to us-east1 --percent 40
alice: change applied, monitoring.

ben: scaling inference-proxy in us-west2 +2 replicas, and restarting kvcache sidecars on problematic pods.
ben: kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/kvcache-proxy -l zone=us-west2

sre_oncall: checking metrics — error-rate drops to 1.9% after shift/restarts :tada:

pagerduty: Incident #INC123456 acknowledged by ben at 06:17:03Z. PD notes: auto-escalation paused.

incident-bot: Note: we hit fallback model for some routes; logs show increased latency by ~120ms.

maria: support update ready: posted on status page 'Partial 5xx errors in us-west2 starting 06:10 UTC; mitigated by rerouting traffic — ongoing monitoring.' Will escalate if enterprise impacted.

ops_lead: keep monitoring 30m; create follow-up ticket for rollback of envoy bump and kvcache investigation. Ben to own P1 -> ticket REDW-2345.

ben: will do a deeper trace and gather logs for postmortem. I'll upload artifacts to the incident folder and summarize.

sre_oncall: closing PD alert for now — monitoring remains open. final observed spike at 06:17:50Z. thanks everyone.
